_comment: Optional Streamable HTTP transport. First run the server as a long-lived process: BRAIN_MCP_TRANSPORT=streamable-http BRAIN_API_KEY=... python -m brain_mcp  (listens on 127.0.0.1:8088). Then point an HTTP-capable MCP client at the URL below. Requires the 'http' extra: pip install -e '.[http]'.
